Game Overview

Space Dodge is a action title where pilot your spaceship through a chaotic cosmic asteroid field in Space Dodge. Master precision and timing to artfully evade looming asteroids and survive longer. Relish the thrill of high-stakes action while aiming for top scores. Skill and strategy are your only allies against the relentless cosmic barrage.
